sources.quote: As a result of our efficiency improvements, we are also lowering the price of these models to $2 / 1M input tokens and $10 / 1M output tokens.
sources.supports: xAI's original announcement gives the official input and output prices for grok-2-vision-1212; it does not state a cache-write price.

notes: xAI announced the $2 input / $10 output rates on Dec 12, 2024. Its announcement does not support models.dev's earlier cache_write: 10 field, so this is best classified as models_dev_fix; the official cache_read rate is not stated in the source. The requested Internet Archive CDX endpoint was unavailable from this workspace, so no snapshot pair could be checked.
